notes.title: Updating the character sprite, what do you think?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024183/0ff23027412931ff26870b196578085765e814fd.gif[/img]

To be completely honest, the current player character sprite looks bad and amateurish. It was created in haste while focusing on other parts of the game. Making the video and screenshots for the Steam page made me realize that improving it should be a priority.

Before updating all directions and event-based animations, I want to share what I've done so far and get your feedback. The first gif in the message is obviously the new sprite, with the gif below as a slightly embarrassing comparison. 🙈
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024183/1290e0e0ce9adfa13ad52aa26f7321d99643c591.gif[/img]
Please share your thoughts with me here or on the Discord server. Is it a boring concept? Can the palette be improved? The animation? Or, if you just like it as it is, let me know. I'm still open to big changes. For starters, the character doesn't look much like a fox anymore, so I would probably need to adjust the species. 🤗

[center][url=https://discord.gg/pjK2ayFgm9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024183/42785ca2b3805cb35ed588c451e3f2d5e73f2b01.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Steam page is live! Join the community.
notes.notes:
The Steam page is finally live! Since you're reading this, it seems our outreach is working 😊. I'd like to take this opportunity to invite you to join our Discord server.

Our goal with the Discord server is to build a community that can help improve the game through input and ideas. I want you and anyone interested to have the chance to influence the game's development and follow the process closely.

On Discord, I'll share updates and content before they're released to the public, including unofficial builds of the game. In fact, [b]a pre-version of the demo is available for Discord members today![/b] Once the public demo is up on Steam, I'll resume work on the [b]Wonder Wand Maker (level editor)[/b] and share early builds with the Discord community.

Sounds interesting? Join here: [url=https://discord.gg/pjK2ayFgm9]https://discord.gg/pjK2ayFgm9[/url]

A special thanks to you early supporters who have found the game! ❤️

Niklas Berg (Pixlas)
